data.name: Sukh
data.gender_notes: Sukh is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: That which brings happiness, peace, and pleasure. The name Sukh carries the meaning “Happiness, Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sukh usually hope their child will grow to embody happiness, bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A state of inner peace and happiness, often attained through spiritual practices and self-realization.
data.etymology: Sukh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happiness, Bliss.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sukh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Sukh means happiness or contentment in Sanskrit. It symbolizes the inner joy and peace that comes from living in harmony with oneself and the universe. It is the essence of bliss and the ultimate goal of life in Hindu philosophy.

historical_references.reference: The Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic poem, mentions a prince named Sukumara. He was the youngest son of King Yayati. Sukumara was a just ruler and a great warrior, who defeated the king of Haihayas and united several kingdoms under his rule.

The Jain texts, including the 'Harivamsa' and 'Kalpa Sutra', mention a merchant named Sukha. He was a wealthy businessman who attained spiritual enlightenment under the guidance of a Jain monk. Sukha's story is an example of renunciation and the pursuit of spiritual growth in ancient India.
historical_references.time_period: circa 5th century BCE to 3rd century CE
